title: FEATURE card frontmatter
description: A coherent unit of future work — the iteration primitive for a project past its initial build. Connect it to every card the feature adds or touches; the body holds intent, scope, and acceptance. Not a ticket tracker: work small enough to be one card's status flip needs no FEATURE card.

release.description: Handle of the RELEASE card this feature targets (or shipped in). A structured ref: it must resolve (E005) and connects the two cards.

branch.description: Git branch the feature is developed on (e.g. feature/auto-assign). Informational — branches are often deleted after merge; the card outlives the branch.

pr.description: Link to the pull request (or commit) that shipped this feature — a URL or short ref like #42. Provenance of the built claim, like verified_sha; set it when the feature merges. Not a changelog.
